decisions: Gable front plane: 3DBAG wall 35 (t 0..2.3, y to 15.8) stands on the front line while the gable face west of t -0.6 is 1.1-1.3 m behind it; gable windows, slot and cross are placed on the measured wall offsets (-1.3 / -1.25 / -1.1 m) so none hovers.

Gable: two four-light windows (sill 7.6 m, 4.6 m tall) either side of the apex, louvred slot above, stone cross, pointed red door in the gabled porch; offsets measured from the straight-on Ruysdaelstraat 37 photo.

Tower: 20.7 m; stepped brick corbel cornice at 15.2-16.2 m, stone clock stage 16.2-19.8 m with a clock on the north and west faces, two louvre slots on the west face (12.3-15.2 m), stone corner posts.

Round stair turret: the 3DBAG ring has a faceted arc (centre -0.9/-6.2 m, r 1.47 m) whose facets are extruded up to the gable roof plane (10.4-12.1 m). The builder drops those seven facets, closes the gable front with one wall plane and builds the turret itself: stone plinth, brick shaft to 5.4 m, corbelled-out base, octagonal oriel 7.15-9.1 m with a window on each front face, white cornice and tiled pyramid roof to 10.7 m (heights from ref-front.jpg and ref-pano-0.jpg).
Parsonage wing (Ruysdaelstraat 37): white painted sashes upstairs, red-framed light and timber door below on the stepped east wall faces (5, 1, 41); two tall lights beside the turret on wall 9.
Colours: sampled brick/mortar mean of ref-front.jpg gable wall is #847670; brick set to #8a766b, grey brick #6f5d55.

Bays: this builder carries its own addBays that sinks every solid 4 cm behind the wall and insets the bars, which removed the coplanar stone/frame faces the audit counted as z-fight (4.8 m2 down to 3.0 m2).
Still inferred: the east wing walls and roofs beyond the photographed 2.5 m of parsonage front (raw 3DBAG massing with windows), and the whole south and west elevations.
